name: crispy spanish tofu plates
instructions:
A collection of SPANISH-register plates on the same basic idea: CRISPY BAKED TOFU (super firm, hand-shredded, starch + seasonings, baked crisp) plated with things that make the protein binge palatable. The tofu core is fixed; the plate rotates — within the spanish register (romesco, andalouse, the tapas direction).

=== THE TOFU CORE (SAME ACROSS ALL VARIANTS) ===

INGREDIENTS:
- super firm tofu (no pressing needed), SHREDDED BY HAND into large rough pieces (or cubed — see shred note)
- cornstarch or potato starch (generous coat)
- garlic powder
- onion powder
- salt
- black pepper
- vegetable oil (toss or drizzle so the starch crisps in the oven)

PROCEDURE:
1. SHRED THE TOFU BY HAND — better than cubing: the FRACTAL EDGES CRISP BETTER (source: Nisha). Tear into large rough bite-sized pieces; cubes/planks still work but the hand-shred is the upgrade.
2. Toss with the starch, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper — HEAVY seasoning hand; tofu is bland baseline and the starch coat has to carry both crunch and flavor.
3. Toss or drizzle with vegetable oil so the coating crisps rather than dusts.
4. Bake at ~425°F on a sheet pan until crisp and browned outside. One pan, no flipping required (flip once if you want more even browning).

=== VARIANT A — ROMESCO PLATE (ROMESCO + HONEY + CHIPS + CHEESE) ===

COMPONENTS:
1. The baked tofu cubes (core recipe above) — with a DRIZZLE OF HONEY over the hot tofu.
2. [[romesco]] as the dip (or a plain romesco).
3. CORN CHIPS or PITA CHIPS for scooping the romesco alongside.
4. A glob of COLD CREAM CHEESE as the second dip (cool-fatty-tangy against the honey-romesco tofu).
5. A SQUEEZE OF LIME over the plate.

EATING IT: honey-drizzled tofu cubes dipped in romesco, chips + romesco between bites. The honey-on-crispy-tofu + smoky-pepper romesco combination covers the sweet-savory-smoky triangle.

=== VARIANT B — CALAMARI PLATE (LEMON + SAUCE ANDALOUSE) ===

COMPONENTS:
1. The baked tofu (core recipe above) — POTATO STARCH specifically, baked crispy, with LOTS of onion/garlic powder.
2. LEMON JUICE squeezed over the hot tofu — NON-OPTIONAL.
3. [[sauce-andalouse]] on top (or as the dip).

EATING IT: the crispy starch crust + lemon + red-pepper mayo reads like a fried-calamari plate — tofu as the squid.
notes:
=== UNRETIRED (SEPTEMBER 2026) ===

Retired in the east asian pruning (the thai/gochujang variant), then brought back without it: the western half was missed. The gochujang plate is gone (git history has it); the ROMESCO PLATE is now variant A, and the collection stays open for new plates.

=== WHY THIS RECIPE EXISTS — MAKING THE PROTEIN BINGE PALATABLE ===

The point of this recipe is eating a LOT of tofu protein in one sitting without it being a chore. The baked starch-crusted cubes are efficient to produce (one sheet pan, no skillet, no flipping) and genuinely pleasant to eat — but a plate of plain tofu cubes gets monotonous fast. The accompaniments are what keep the binge palatable: dips, fresh vegetables, acid, crunch. Each variant is a different answer to 'what goes around the cubes.'

This file COLLECTS VARIANTS of that formula as they develop. The tofu core stays fixed; the plate rotates.

=== THE TOFU CORE — RULES ===

- SUPER FIRM TOFU: no pressing needed, holds the cube shape, maximum protein density. Firm works if pressed but super firm is the recipe.
- SHRED BY HAND OVER CUBING: manually torn tofu has FRACTAL EDGES that crisp better than clean cube faces (source: Nisha). Keep the pieces large — big shreds read as the meal; small crumbles read as a garnish.
- HEAVY SEASONING HAND: tofu is bland baseline. Starch + garlic powder + onion powder + salt + pepper, all generous. Under-seasoned tofu turns the whole plate flat.
- VEGETABLE OIL SO THE STARCH CRISPS: dry starch coat bakes to dust; oiled starch coat bakes to crust. Toss or drizzle before the bake.
- HOT OVEN (~425°F): under-crisped tofu reads soggy/boiled. The crisp exterior is what makes the cubes snackable at volume.

=== VARIANT B NOTES (CALAMARI PLATE) ===

LEMON IS NON-OPTIONAL here — the calamari read collapses without the acid.

THE CALAMARI READ: potato-starch-crusted baked tofu + lemon juice + [[sauce-andalouse]] lands on the fried-calamari register — crispy coating, bright acid, and the spiced mayo doing the aioli job. POTATO STARCH specifically for this one (the crispest crust), and a heavy hand on the onion/garlic powder.

=== VARIANT A NOTES (ROMESCO PLATE) ===

HONEY DRIZZLE ON THE TOFU: drizzle over the hot cubes right out of the oven — the heat loosens the honey and it coats rather than clumps. Sweet-on-crispy-savory is the hook.

CREAM CHEESE — COLD, AS THE SECOND DIP: keep it cold for the temperature contrast against the hot tofu; alternating the smoky romesco and the cool cream cheese keeps the plate interesting.

LIME ON THE ROMESCO PLATE: I like a squeeze of lime over this one — lime for the romesco plate, lemon for the calamari plate; each plate gets its own citrus.

ROMESCO: [[romesco]] is the house version (smoky fire-roasted peppers + almonds + ancho). The smoky-nutty dip against the honey-sweet tofu covers the sweet-savory-smoky triangle.

CHIPS: corn chips or pita chips — they're the romesco delivery vehicle between tofu bites, and the crunch variety (chip-crunch vs starch-crust-crunch) keeps the texture interesting. This also matches the romesco serving guidance (dip with crackers/pita — see [[romesco]]'s serving note).

=== FAILURE MODES ===

TOFU UNDER-SEASONED OR UNDER-CRISPED: the cubes carry every variant. Under-seasoned = flat plate; under-crisped = soggy/boiled register. Hot oven, generous starch, generous seasoning, enough oil.

=== HISTORICAL NOTE — RENAMED FROM ITALIAN-ASIAN-TOFU-PLATE ===

This file was previously 'italian asian tofu plate' — a deconstruction of [[italian-stuffed-bell-peppers]] (basil + parsley + gochujang + bell pepper + cream cheese, plated). That build survives as Variant A (thai plate), lightly renamed and simplified. The recipe's identity shifted from 'deconstructed stuffed peppers' to 'variant collector for the tofu-cube protein formula' — the tofu core turned out to be the real recipe, and the accompaniments are interchangeable plates around it.

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[italian-stuffed-bell-peppers]]: the assembled, oven-baked, composed dish that Variant A descends from. Same flavor family, more work, presents better for others.
- [[romesco]]: the dip for Variant B.
